Definition: to do, make, prepare, keep, etc.
BiblicalUsage: In the Aramaic chapters of Daniel and Ezra this is the everyday word for doing, making, and serving. The accusers charge that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego 'serve not thy gods'; Darius tells Daniel that the God 'whom thou servest continually' will deliver him; and the vision promises that all peoples 'shall serve' the Son of Man.
TheologicalSignificance: Two kinds of service face off in Daniel: serving the king's gods, and serving the living God. I hold that the three friends and Daniel show what true service costs — it can put you in a furnace or a lions' den — and that the God they served is the one every nation will serve in the end.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace; Daniel in the Lions' Den
